profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Hi, I'm Adam! I'm a software engineer with a background in art and computer science. Making things and solving problems is what I love doing. In my 10 year tech career I have helped brands launch successful products to millions of customers - from start, to finish, and beyond. So far that list includes desktop and mobile apps, websites, browser extensions, and gaming accessories.
